profile.headline: Lead Application Developer at New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Results-driven IT leader with over 18 years of experience progressing from Senior Application Developer/Director to Lead Application Developer within NYC government. Specializes in architecting large-scale, mission-critical applications within the Microsoft ecosystem, with deep expertise in web-based technologies, database management systems, solution architecture, SOAP & REST-based integrations, DevOps, and enterprise-wide modernization. Recognized for strong technical leadership, cross-system integration strategy, architectural governance, and a forward-looking approach aligned with agency priorities.

company.name: New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description:
• Direct the technical execution of application projects, ensuring architectural alignment, code quality, and strong delivery to the agency’s technology roadmap.
• Analyze business needs and recommend secure, scalable technical solutions across enterprise applications.
• Lead development lifecycle activities, resolving complex technical issues and ensuring timely, high‑quality releases.
• Enforce development standards and best practices to maintain consistency and long-term maintainability.
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders throughout requirement, development, and release phases.
• Write and review high‑quality, secure code for critical components ensuring strong functionality.
• Provide hands‑on technical mentorship, including paired coding and structured code reviews.
• Document technical solutions and ensure compliance with internal policies.
• Monitor system performance, troubleshoot proactively, and ensure stability of mission‑critical applications.

positions.title: Director
positions.description:
• Oversaw full lifecycle development of mission-critical systems supporting licensing, enforcement, legal, inspections, and internal operations.
• Led integrations between Dynamics 365, Accela, OATH, DOF, DOTF, ECB, USPS, and Google Maps.
• Spearheaded adoption of SOA and RESTful API standards.
• Managed development resources, project planning, and performance oversight.
• Created DevOps templates and dashboards; migrated legacy source control to Azure DevOps.
• Provided solution architectural guidance on CRM extensions, plugins, entity modeling, security roles, and solution layering.
• Defined integration patterns for Dynamics 365 using .NET and REST APIs.
• Collaborated with DBA and Cybersecurity teams to ensure CRM security, auditing, and compliance.
• Supported Power Platform adoption including model-driven apps and Power Automate.
• Defined end‑to‑end CRM solution architecture ensuring alignment between data models, integrations, security, and application layers.
• Established and governed REST‑based integration patterns to ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable interoperability across agency systems.
• Enforced solution layering, configuration standards, and structured ALM practices across Dynamics 365 environments.
• Contributed to Dataverse entity modeling and cross‑system data alignment supporting consistent and accurate data structures.
• Performed architectural design reviews identifying technical risks and recommending mitigation strategies aligned with enterprise best practices.
• Applied working knowledge of Power Platform (model‑driven apps, canvas apps, Power Automate) in CRM solution design with continued advancement toward automation expertise.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Progressed from Senior Developer to Director of Application Development, later transitioning to Lead Application Developer.
• Deep institutional knowledge across DCWP systems, architecture, workflows, and inter-agency integrations.
• Accela-to-Dynamics CRM 365 Conversion: Key contributor in architectural design, migration strategy, and modernization.
• Designed Inspection Management System (Dynamics 365) and Accela integrations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Experienced in web application development:
- Designed and developed scalable n-tier web applications using ASP.NET 2.0/3.5, VB.NET, and ADO.NET, adhering to object-oriented programming principles.
- Implemented front-end solutions with jQuery, AJAX, AJAXControlToolkit, and jQuery UI to enhance interactivity and responsiveness.
- Integrated Infragistics controls for advanced UI functionalities, improving user experience and application responsiveness.
- Utilized remote scripting techniques to optimize client-server communication across distributed environments.
- Integrated VBScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for dynamic client-side functionalities and responsive web design.
- Leveraged XML for data interchange and configuration, ensuring flexibility and configurability across application tiers.

Specialized in database development and optimization:
- Designed and optimized databases using SQL Server 2000/2005/2008, developing complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and views to support n-tier architecture.
- Improved query performance by 30% through SQL Profiler, Database Engine Tuning Advisor, and strategic indexing.
- Implemented SQL Server Reporting Services 2005 for customized reporting solutions, enhancing data visualization and business intelligence capabilities.

Additional skills and tools:
- Utilized CMDshell scripting for efficient access and parsing of large files in n-tier environments.
- Implemented Log4Net for comprehensive logging and error tracking, ensuring robust application performance.
- Integrated FileNet for effective document management in distributed web applications, optimizing document storage and retrieval.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Parsippany, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Experienced in automating solutions and enhancing modules:
- Automated customer-requested solutions with ASP.NET and C#, significantly boosting efficiency and reducing operational time.
- Implemented major enhancements for Sales & Service modules at Nissan Australia using C#.NET and ADO.NET, elevating system capabilities and user satisfaction.

Specialized in web application development:
- Designed interactive GUIs with ASP.NET Web Forms (2.0/VB.NET), integrating Component Art web controls and dotnetcharting for advanced data visualization.
- Leveraged JavaScript and Remote Scripting (partial AJAX) extensively to enhance user interactivity and responsiveness.

Proficient in data integration and reporting:
- Extracted, transformed, and loaded data from SQL Server databases and text files into SQL Server Data Warehouse using DTS packages, ADO.NET, and C#, creating comprehensive reports with SSRS.

Expert in database optimization:
- Redesigned and optimized database schema, stored procedures, and DTS packages, enhancing system performance through SQL query optimization and tools like SQL Profiler and Index Tuning Advisor.
- Led database upgrades from SQL Server 2000 to SQL Server 2005 using Microsoft Upgrade Advisor and converted DTS Packages to SSIS packages using DTSxChange.

Skilled in project coordination:
- Coordinated with clients and application teams, managing monthly production release schedules and deployments effectively.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.locationName: Parsippany, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description: Experienced in ASP.NET Web Forms and Infragistics controls for advanced GUI development, focusing on enhancing user experience and interface design. Proficient in JavaScript and Remote Scripting (partial AJAX) for critical functionalities like Session Time Out Warning/Renew Session and Auto Fill for Dropdown boxes, improving system responsiveness and user interaction. Developed robust Business Logic Components in C#.NET for seamless server-side validations to ensure smooth business flow and data integrity. Created a secure Web Service for SKU inventory information across domains, enhancing data accessibility for Sales. Optimized SQL Server 2000/2005 stored procedures, achieving a 30% efficiency boost. Skilled in creating efficient data views from AS400 Data Warehouse Star Schema for effective reporting with large datasets.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: Experienced in designing and developing robust software solutions with expertise in ASP.NET Web Forms and Infragistics controls for superior GUI functionality. Proficient in XML Configuration for flexible updates, ASP.NET User Controls for customizable interfaces, and JavaScript for client-side validations. Skilled in creating secure Web Services for financial data integration across locations. Experienced with SQL Server (2000/2005), adept at optimizing performance with Stored Procedures, Cursors, and DTS for seamless data migration. Utilizes UML and Enterprise Architect for clear project guidance and implements Visual Source Safe for efficient version control and team collaboration.
